title: Programiz: Sort Words in Alphabetic Order
description: Given a sentence `sentence`, split it into words and return the words sorted in alphabetical order (case-insensitive, returned in lowercase).
constraints:
1 <= len(sentence) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(N)

input.sentence: Hello this Is a Example With cased letters

explanation: Tokenizes words into lowercase and sorts alphabetically in O(N log N) time.
